experiment_data.hypothesis: SFT Qwen3-8B on ALFWorld expert data (2460 examples) to create 8B SFT checkpoint for subsequent RL training (Cell A vs C). Also tests westd stability with non-Ray workload (torchrun). SFT is mandatory for fair comparison with 1.7B experiments (same pipeline: base → SFT → RL).

spec.command: source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3 torchrun --nproc_per_node=4 scripts/sft_train_8b.py

experiment_data.notes: Final: loss=0.0355, token_accuracy=98.56%, 231/231 steps, 3 epochs. FSDP full_shard 4xRTX PRO 6000. DDP OOM → FSDP resolved. TMPDIR fix (M017) prevented root partition overflow. Checkpoint saving 7 shards to /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/qwen3_8b_sft_v1/.
